title: CISA Third-Party Data Breach
response: The Treasury Department treated the event as a major cybersecurity incident, alerted Congressional committees, and BeyondTrust/CISA conducted a forensic investigation which confirmed that the breach was limited to the Treasury Department.
origin: Chinese state-backed threat actors (APT27 / Silk Typhoon)
additionalNotes: Threat actors exploited a vulnerability in BeyondTrust remote support software using a stolen remote API key. They remotely accessed user workstations at the US Department of the Treasury and viewed unclassified documents.
